title: Java Full Stack Developer
description:
Java Full Stack Developer – Fresher

**Company:** Monarch Softwares  
**Job Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** Fresher (0–1 Year)

Job Description

Monarch Softwares is looking for enthusiastic and motivated freshers to join our development team as Java Full Stack Developers. Candidates will have the opportunity to work on web application development, learn industry-standard technologies, and contribute to real-time software projects under the guidance of experienced team members.

Roles and Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain web applications using Java-based technologies.
* Work on backend development using Java, Spring Boot, and REST APIs.
* Build responsive user interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React.js or Angular.
* Work with databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL.
* Assist in integrating frontend applications with backend services.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve application issues.
* Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code.
* Collaborate with developers and team members throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Participate in code reviews, testing, and project discussions.

Required Skills

* Basic knowledge of Java programming and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP).
* Understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Familiarity with SQL and relational databases.
* Basic understanding of web application development.
* Knowledge of Spring Boot, REST APIs, React.js, or Angular is an added advantage.
* Good problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and work on practical projects.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply through Indeed with their updated resume.

**Contact Details:**

* **Email:** hr@placements.com
* **Phone:** 6385753874

Join Monarch Softwares and begin your career in Java Full Stack Development!

Pay: ₹250,000.00 - ₹350,000.00 per year

description:

**Role Overview**
-----------------

This is a critical position, and we are looking to close the role at the earliest.

We are looking for an experienced Data Architect / Data Lead with 15+ years of overall IT experience and strong hands-on experience in data architecture, data engineering, and enterprise data solutions.

The ideal candidate should have progressed through hands-on data engineering/technical roles into a Data Lead or Data Architect position, with the ability to provide both strategic architectural direction and practical technical leadership.

We are particularly interested in candidates who are not purely architecture-focused, but have strong hands-on technical experience as a Data Lead/Data Engineering Lead and have grown into an architecture role.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Define and implement enterprise-level data architecture and data strategies aligned with business requirements.
* Lead the design of scalable, secure, and high-performance data platforms and solutions.
* Provide hands-on technical leadership across data engineering, data integration, data modeling, and data management.
* Design and review data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, data warehouses, data lakes, and modern data platforms.
* Lead technical discussions with business stakeholders, engineering teams, and senior leadership.
* Establish standards for data modeling, architecture, governance, quality, security, and performance.
* Evaluate existing data platforms and recommend modernization opportunities.
* Guide development teams on architecture, technology selection, coding standards, and best practices.
* Troubleshoot complex data and performance issues and provide technical solutions.
* Ensure data solutions are scalable, reliable, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise architecture principles.
* Mentor senior developers, data engineers, and technical leads.
* Participate in architecture reviews, solution design, estimation, and technical documentation.
* Required Technical Experience
* 15+ years of overall IT experience, with significant experience in data technologies.
* Proven experience working as a Data Architect, Data Lead, Technical Lead, or equivalent senior data role.
* Strong hands-on experience in data architecture and data engineering.
* Expertise in data modeling, including conceptual, logical, and physical data models.
* Strong understanding of data warehouse and data lake architectures.
* Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT and data integration frameworks.
* Strong SQL and database development experience.
* Experience with one or more major cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with modern data technologies such as Spark, Databricks, Snowflake, Kafka, or equivalent platforms is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of distributed data processing and large-scale data systems.
* Experience designing APIs/data integration solutions and working with enterprise applications.
* Understanding of data governance, data quality, security, metadata management, and master data management.
* Leadership & Communication
* Strong ability to translate business requirements into technical data architecture.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to lead architecture discussions and influence technical decisions.
* Comfortable working directly with clients and senior management.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to work independently while leading cross-functional technical teams.
* Must be willing to work on-site from Coimbatore.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
------------------------------------

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience in enterprise-scale data transformation or modernization programs.
* Experience leading large-scale data migration initiatives.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Relevant cloud/data certifications are an advantage.
* Ideal Candidate
* 15+ years | Data Architecture | Hands-on Data Lead Experience | Cloud & Modern Data Platforms | Strong Technical Leadership | Coimbatore On-site

title: .NET Full Stack Developer - US Client Engagement & AI Solutions
description:
We are seeking a talented **.NET Full Stack Developer** with a passion for **AI Solutions** and client\-facing engagements to join our dynamic team in Coimbatore. In this role, you will work closely with **US\-based clients**, bridging business requirements with cutting\-edge technical execution. The ideal candidate should have **6 months to 1 year of experience** in C\# and .NET development, along with a strong foundation in modern cloud architectures, REST APIs, and basic AI/ML integrations. If you thrive in agile environments and want to build the next generation of intelligent software, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

* **Client Engagement \& Collaboration:** Directly interact with US\-based stakeholders to gather requirements, provide technical updates, and deliver robust software solutions tailored to their business objectives.
* **Full Stack Development:** Design, develop, and maintain high\-quality, scalable applications using **C\#, .NET Core, and modern front\-end frameworks**.
* **AI Solutions Integration:** Integrate artificial intelligence and machine learning capabilities (such as GCP Vertex AI, ADK, MCP and LLM\-based APIs) into enterprise applications.
* **Cloud \& DevOps:** Leverage **Azure Services** and utilize **Docker** for containerization, collaborating with the DevOps team to streamline continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
* **API \& Database Management:** Build, secure, and consume **REST APIs**, managing backend data efficiently using **SQL** and modern database technologies.
* **Code Quality \& Agile Delivery:** Write clean, testable, and maintainable code following **Agile Scrum methodologies**, actively participating in code reviews and architecture discussions.
* **Performance \& Security:** Implement industry best practices for application security, scalability, performance tuning, and troubleshooting complex software issues.

Requirements

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* **Experience:** Professional experience in **C\# and .NET Core development**.
* **AI \& Cloud Acumen:** Familiarity or hands\-on experience integrating AI solutions
* **Client\-Facing Skills:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills with proven experience or readiness to manage **US client communications and presentations**.
* **Core Technical Stack:** Strong working knowledge of **REST APIs, SQL, and modern front\-end technologies**.
* **DevOps \& Containerization:** Familiarity with **Docker**, containerization, and basic DevOps practices.
* **Methodology \& Soft Skills:** Strong understanding of **Agile Scrum**, exceptional problem\-solving abilities, high attention to detail, and the capability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment.
